rights_policy.rule: Deutsche Post products, BKG PLZ, GA/HK-DE, HU-DE, LoD2-DE and open VG25 remain independently versioned evidence artifacts with separate access and publication rights.
rights_policy.attribution: Every artifact records provider, product, edition or retrieval time, state partition, access class, contract, schema, CRS, digest, transformation and required source reference.

sources.production_scope: Pinned search receipts for individual validation only; automated bulk extraction and redistribution require separate review.
sources.terms_note: Public interactive search is current assignment evidence but is not a bulk geometry or address redistribution license.

sources.production_scope: Pinned contracted BASIC, STREETCODE, BUILDINGS or GEOCODE artifact with product edition, permitted fields, permitted uses and redistribution receipt.
sources.terms_note: DATAFACTORY products are offered commercially. GEOCODE supplies postcode areas and point coordinates; BUILDINGS and STREETCODE are distinct products with distinct rights and update cycles.

sources.provider: Federal Agency for Cartography and Geodesy (BKG), data owner Deutsche Post Direkt GmbH
sources.production_scope: Pinned BKG download or service artifact available to authorized federal users after license agreement, with Deutsche Post Direkt attribution and contract receipt.
sources.terms_note: The product contains original Deutsche Post Direkt geometry for valid five-digit delivery postcode areas on German territory. It excludes non-area codes such as large recipients and specified Austrian routing areas.

sources.provider: Federal Agency for Cartography and Geodesy (BKG), based on GeoBasis-DE / ZSHH
sources.production_scope: Pinned GA CSV release available only to its authorized user class, with state/source lineage, schema, UTM32s CRS and rights receipt.
sources.terms_note: GA combines nationwide addresses, coordinates and administrative keys and is restricted to an eligible user class. It is address-point evidence, not postcode-area or building-footprint geometry.

sources.provider: German state surveying authorities via GeoBasis-DE / ZSHH
sources.production_scope: Pinned HK-DE release for an authorized user under the applicable V GeoBund or V GeoLänder terms, including state-specific notes and coordinate quality.
sources.terms_note: HK-DE positions addressed buildings from state cadastres. National delivery is access-restricted and state-specific details remain material to use and publication.

sources.provider: German state surveying authorities via GeoBasis-DE / ZSHH
sources.production_scope: Pinned HU-DE state partition for an authorized user, preserving object identifier, AGS, building function, CRS, edition, state notes and rights receipt.
sources.terms_note: HU-DE supplies accurate ALK/DFK-derived building outlines and object identifiers. AGS aligns administrative context with HK-DE but does not by itself link one address to one building.

sources.provider: German state surveying authorities via GeoBasis-DE / ZSHH and BKG
sources.production_scope: Pinned LoD2-DE state/tile release for an authorized user with CityGML profile, UTM zone, object and 2D references, optional addresses, edition and rights receipt.
sources.terms_note: LoD2-DE contains standardized roof-form 3D models and may carry addresses or 2D references. Optional attributes and state differences must be measured per release.

sources.provider: Federal Agency for Cartography and Geodesy (BKG) with German state data providers
sources.production_scope: Pinned annual VG25 edition with level, identifier, validity, CRS, digest, provider list, CC BY 4.0 attribution and transformation record.
sources.terms_note: VG25 is public administrative geometry under CC BY 4.0. Its boundaries provide context and clipping, never Deutsche Post assignment or PLZ geometry.

artifact_partitions.contains: contracts, schemas, receipts and non-geographic synthetic fixtures only
DATAFACTORY product artifacts and rights receipts
BKG PLZ, GA, HK-DE, HU-DE and LoD2-DE artifacts for authorized users
pinned VG25 administrative artifacts and transformations
state-specific access, attribution, exceptions and publication decisions
DE sovereign partition and separately governed foreign routing exceptions
